I've been playing this game (non-consistently) since it's birth, around 2016. It was a blast to be able to play a hero shooter on such an awful laptop, and I think that's the main thing to point out about this game, it can basically run in any computer or laptop. I remember being so excited about playing an Overwatch similar, in those days the game was truly great. No unnecessary in-game transactions, you could buy regular lootboxes with gold (regular coin of the game), and the lootboxes had a chance to give you rare skins. As someone who didn't had money to spend in games, that was such a breath of fresh air.

The strategy factor also made me have tons of fun, Paladins working fairly different from other hero shooters and FPSs from it's time. It might be the nostalgia talking, but I think that, at it's prime, this game might've been one of the most entertaining things around.

The first change that didn't please me was the fact that you couldn't buy lootboxes with gold anymore, you needed to acquire the payed coin of the game (crystals). Although it didn't present any threat to the gameplay, I was extremely disappointed, since the only way to acquire crystals at the time was through daily rewards or buying it with real money. It was sad to see that I wouldn't be able to acquire something that should be accessible for all players, but whatever, I went on playing.

The game went through other bad changes (I will forever hate elixir), decisions that made it a pay to win for a while. And then I took my first hiatus. Year after year I tried to come back to this game, only to see it get worse and worse. I was never really a fan of battle passes, specially the ones you need to pay for.

It's very sad to me, to see the potential of this game being wasted in such a way. I've came back recently to get all the achievements, and I had as much fun as I had years ago. If only this game got the treatment it deserved...

Through this review, I want to register my love and passion for this game, I'll never regret the hours spent on it, and while this game is still running, I recommend you to give it a chance. It doesn't get updates, and it's probably just a matter of time until the servers are shut down, but I still think that the experience is worth it. Don't let this chance go to waste, play it while we still have time.

I truly love this game, and I dearly hope it gets a new chance to shine in the future, even if I don't really feel like playing it anymore.

So... Not sure what happened here.

There have been changed made that, frankly, make the game very unfun. This isn't even about the truly awful Thanos event (Though that definitely deserves to be mentioned given the timing) but rather, two specific things that have slowly but surely punished their most ardent players:

1. Match Making Punishes Good Players:
   So, if you happen to be good or even great at the game, the matchmaking punishes you. If you can't help but notice it feels like either you are the only person on your team that seems to be doing well, OR you haven't seen anyone else carry the game on your side lately, that means that YOU are victim to this. Basically, instead of trying to keep the general skill level even among the team, it will pull specifically well performing players and pair them up with people on massive lose streaks or consistently underperforming to increase their chances to win. The result of this, instead, "rewards" trolls who are just messing around and never had an interest to win by bringing in some poor sucker into a doomed game, effectively punishing players that do okay by purposefully giving them terrible teammates.

   This wasn't a problem with the earlier seasons, so I don't understand why they thought they needed to fix this now. Every team had an equal mix of Unemployed God-Tier DPS or Spiderman Death Montage Fisher on both sides. It felt a lot more random. This was probably done in an attempt to fix that, bur frankly, this is so much worse. You don't even need to be Celestial to feel this, it's literally in Quick Play too, and it just makes your biggest fans (The people who spend the most time in this game and actually get okay at it) feel like their game quality has gone down, and that's because it HAS. 

2. Console Players Now Have Weird Advantages:
    This one kinda baffles me. Most games separate the PC and Console community in shooter games for good reason: The PC players are far far more accurate and can perform leagues better than console players who are limited by joy-stick aiming and movement. This, usually, makes it very unfair for the console players and so even the playerbase wants a hard separation (See games like Apex Legends). But, it is a bit different in this game. They don't separate them at all. Console players get some tools to even the playing field like a auto-aim so they don't need to actually aim nearly as well. This is, actually fine. It's still generally not as good as mouse and keyboard (You can circle strafe around console players at close range and see the blatantly crutch as they literally cannot turn fast enough) and while it was always annoying to have a bunch of console players on your team, they changed something...

   I don't even know how to describe it. It's like some kind of input correction? Basically, just because you are aiming and shooting at a console player as a PC player now, if they aren't there on the CONSOLE player's side, then that shot misses. You, as the PC player, could have spot on aim and still miss now. It's kinda insane. This definitely wasn't a problem before, and I don't know why it's here now, but it successfully flipped the paradigm and now console players get so much hand-holding benefits that it's actually more to your advantage to have as many console players on your team as possible. 

This is, obviously, pretty awful if you value your own time as a PC player since you are actively punished for having good aim. This shouldn't be the case in any shooter ever, and it's insane that they decided to do this. This being a review on Steam, it should reflect in the reviews for PC players, and honestly if you do play this on PC, you should be rightfully pissed.
